propositions: _fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD, making the heal result dependent on the checked-out branch, causing refusal when current_branch != ref
The refusal guard _require_tracker_on_ref prevents healing trackers on side branches or detached HEAD, but this can be avoided by folding into refs/heads/<ref> directly instead of worktree HEAD
git merge-tree --write-tree honours the tracker's ours merge driver and .gitattributes merge policy identically to git merge, avoiding the need for a scratch worktree
_publish_and_prune currently assumes the guard establishes that ref IS the checked-out branch, and bundles HEAD instead of explicitly bundling refs/heads/<ref>

After the rewrite, off-branch and detached-HEAD trackers must heal successfully without moving the checked-out branch or worktree, while on-branch heals must keep index and worktree consistent via git reset --hard
